events.event: BNPB recorded 678 hectares of forest and land fires across five provinces as of 14:00 WIB on 31 Oct, with PM2.5 air quality at hazardous level in Jambi and Central Kalimantan.
events.key_numbers: 678 ha total · Kalteng 403 ha/547 hotspots · Kalsel 189 ha/132 · Kalbar 41 ha/13 · Sumsel 37 ha/39 · Jambi 8 ha · hazardous: Jambi, Kalteng · unhealthy: Riau, Sumsel, Kalsel, IKN
events.why_it_matters: Haze affects health, flights and school days for millions in Sumatra and Kalimantan.

events.event: BNPB says most hotspots in Merauke, South Papua, over the past three days were inside private palm-oil concessions and indicates some land was deliberately burned.
events.key_numbers: Monitoring via drones and digital systems · hotspots in Merauke and Okaba · BNPB head Kristomei Sianturi · BNPB earlier said South Papua hotspots fell 78% (30 Oct)
events.why_it_matters: Ties burning to plantation concessions, a recurring accountability question.

events.event: BMKG issues rain warnings for 30 Oct-2 Nov: heavy to very heavy rain alert in West Kalimantan, moderate rain in Aceh, North Sumatra, West Java and others, and strong winds in several provinces including Banten and West Java.
events.key_numbers: Siaga (heavy-very heavy rain): Kalbar · strong winds: Sumbar, Bengkulu, Lampung, Banten, Jabar, Jatim, Sulsel · media report heavy rain alerts for Jabar and Aceh on 1-2 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Rain at the start of the wet season can mean floods and landslides, but also relief from haze.
events.spreading_evidence: Kompas TV and Bisnis headlines on BMKG early warnings 1-2 Nov

events.event: BMKG says a very strong El Nino with positive IOD is deepening dry conditions, with maximum temperatures of 38C or more recorded in Lampung, West Java and East Java, and rainfall for first ten days of November mostly medium.
events.key_numbers: Tmax >=38C (22-25 Oct) · high-confidence hotspots in 10 days: Kalimantan 4,098, South Papua 879, South Sumatra 784 · Dasarian I Nov: medium rain 77.72% of area, low 20.72%, high 1.56% · Aceh 187 mm/day rain 22-25 Oct
events.why_it_matters: Explains why it is both scorching and smoky while some regions flood.
